title: ESPRIT DOA
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/ESPRIT_DOA.md
text: ESPRIT direction of arrival (DOA) estimator for ULA, 1 input, 1 output, {Null axis direction} sets Null axis direction; {Signal propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Operating frequency (Hz)} sets the system operating frequency 3e8, {Number of signals}, {Spatial smoothing} enables spatial smoothing, {Type of least squares method}, {Forward-backward averaging} enables forward-backward averaging, {Row weighting factor}, {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted, {Specify sensor array as} sets the method to specify array Array, {Element type} sets the array element types, {Operating frequency range (Hz)} sets the operating frequency range of the antenna or microphone element, {Baffle the back of the element} sets the back response of an Isotropic Antenna element or an Omni Microphone element, {Exponent of cosine pattern} sets the exponents of azimuth and elevation cosine patterns, {Operating frequency vector (Hz)} sets the operating frequency range of custom antenna or microphone elements, {Frequency responses (dB)} sets the antenna and microphone frequency response, {Input Pattern Coordinate System} sets the coordinate system of custom antenna pattern, {Azimuth angles (deg)} sets the azimuth angles of antenna radiation pattern, {Elevation angles (deg)} sets the elevation angles of antenna radiation pattern, {Phi Angles (deg)} sets the phi angle coordinates of custom antenna radiation pattern, {Theta Angles (deg)} sets the theta angle coordinates of custom antenna radiation pattern, {Magnitude pattern (dB)} sets the magnitude of combined antenna radiation pattern, {Phase pattern (deg)} sets the custom antenna radiation phase pattern, {Align element normal with array normal}, {Radiation pattern beamwidth (deg)} sets the radiation pattern beamwidth, {Polar pattern frequencies (Hz)} sets the polar pattern microphone response frequencies, {Polar pattern angles (deg)} sets the polar pattern response angles, {Polar pattern (dB)} sets the custom microphone polar response zeros, {Number of elements} sets the number of array elements in U, {Element spacing} sets the distance between ULA elements, {Array axis} sets the linear axis direction, {Taper} sets the uLA array taper and {Expression} sets the mATLAB expression used to create an array Phased Array System Toolbox™ array System. Values come from the instance.
